applications.name: Apple Notes
applications.purpose: Used for short-term note-taking, to-do lists, find, read, edit, delete,list all notes, and open notes in the Apple Notes app.

applications.name: Obsidian
applications.purpose: Used for story-writing, journaling, and managing Markdown stories and documents in the local Obsidian vault, including exact-passage edits, search, folder operations, and opening documents for review.

applications.name: Calendar
applications.purpose: Used to manage events and native alerts in the macOS default Calendar, log daily progress locally, and summarize work across a date range.

applications.name: Browser
applications.purpose: Search the live web and YouTube, compare and read public pages, check URL reputation, and open selected links in Safari without downloading files.
